s.note: the giant warehouse store of the future
s.how: Melt 60g butter with 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 2 tsp dried ranch seasoning, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1/2 tsp garlic powder. Toss with 150g pretzels, 150g corn chips, 150g cheese crackers and 150g roasted peanuts in a large roasting tin. Bake at 150C for 30 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes. Cool on the tray so it crisps, then tip into a very big bowl.

s.n: Future cheese fries with chicken salt
s.how: Bake 1kg frozen chips at 220C for 25 minutes and toss with 2 tsp chicken salt. Grill 4 rashers bacon until crisp and chop. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour, whisk in 250ml milk and simmer until thick. Stir in 150g grated cheddar and 1/2 tsp mustard until smooth. Pile the chips on a platter, pour over the cheese sauce and scatter with bacon and sliced spring onion.

m.note: Joe teaching them to water the crops
m.how: Marinate 600g chicken breast in 2 tbsp olive oil, the zest and juice of 1 lemon, 1 crushed garlic clove and 1 tsp dried oregano for 20 minutes. Grill 6 minutes a side, rest and slice. Grill 2 corn cobs and cut off the kernels. Whisk 100ml buttermilk, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, chopped chives and dill. Toss 2 chopped cos lettuces, 250g halved cherry tomatoes, 1 sliced cucumber and 1 avocado. Top with chicken and corn and drizzle with dressing.

w.note: waking up 500 years in the future
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g caster sugar, add 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 120ml milk. Divide between 12 cupcake cases and bake at 180C for 18 minutes. Cool, cut a small hole in each and fill with 1 tsp raspberry jam. Beat 150g butter with 300g icing sugar, 50g mashed raspberries and a few drops of blue colouring until fluffy. Pipe on top and finish with silver sprinkles.

d.note: Brawndo, it's got what plants crave
d.how: Blend 1 Lebanese cucumber, a handful of mint leaves, the juice of 4 limes, the juice of 2 oranges, 3 tbsp honey and a pinch of salt until smooth. Strain into a jug and chill for 30 minutes. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, pour in the green mix to halfway and top up with 600ml cold soda water. Stir and garnish with lime wheels.
